records.translation: 1. 如果模型尚未保存到磁盘，则先保存 -- ``spawn`` 工作进程只能通过文件系统访问它；2. 设置 :data:`MODEL_ENV_VAR` 和 :data:`ON_MISSING_ENV_VAR`；3. 将 ``spacr.illumination:install`` 追加到 ``SPACR_MEASURE_HOOKS``（是追加而不是赋值 -- 其他扩展可能已经在其中），然后查询注册表，使本进程也通过同一条环境变量途径安装钩子。启动工作进程前，会将现有照明钩子替换为所选模型的钩子。

A non-empty ``illumination_vendor_profile`` replaces the estimate with the vendor's own flat microscope field of view; ``illumination_vendor_channel_map`` optionally assigns persisted image data channels to vendor image data channels/image layers. ``illumination_model`` still wins over both. records.source: settings carrying the illumination controls. A non-empty ``illumination_vendor_profile`` replaces the estimate with the vendor's own flat field; ``illumination_vendor_channel_map`` optionally assigns persisted channels to vendor channels/planes. ``illumination_model`` still wins over both. After successful preparation, mutable settings receive the absolute model path so saving and reloading them reuses the fitted model.
records.translation: 携带照明控制项的设置。非空的 ``illumination_vendor_profile`` 会用厂商自己的平场替代估计结果；``illumination_vendor_channel_map`` 可选地把持久化的通道分配到厂商的通道/图像层。``illumination_model`` 仍然优先于这两者。准备成功后，可变设置会记录模型的绝对路径，以便保存并重新加载这些设置时复用已拟合的模型。
